meta.subject: fix bitwidth issue in PE.scala when WS-only dataflow is used

en.summary: Fixes the WS-only PE MAC operand typing so the MAC addend uses the WS output-path width rather than the narrower input-path type.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly identifies a bit-width issue in the PE when WS-only dataflow is used.
The patch changes the PE MAC unit instantiation in src/main/scala/gemmini/PE.scala, which is core DUT hardware logic.
The new instantiation uses outputType for the WS-only addend path instead of the old cType path that resolved to inputType in WS mode.
evidence: Before the fix, cType resolved to inputType in WS mode and the MAC was instantiated with that narrower addend type.
The fix changes the MAC instantiation so WS mode uses outputType for the addend input instead.
In the WS branch, mac_unit.io.in_c is driven from b, which is already typed as outputType, so the fix aligns the helper type with the real datapath operand.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a weight-stationary processing element, the feedback or addend operand entering the MAC can be wider than the raw multiplicand inputs. The old WS-only typing instantiated the MAC helper with the narrower input-path type for that addend operand instead of the WS output-path type. Reintroducing that mismatch recreates a width or truncation error in the WS accumulation path.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: PE MAC addend width selection in weight-stationary mode
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The PE is built or exercised in a WS-only configuration where the output or partial-sum path is wider than the input operand type.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Instantiate the MAC helper or DSP wrapper with the narrower input type for the addend or feedback operand instead of the WS output type.
portability_notes: Apply this only to designs whose WS datapath feeds back a value wider than the raw multiplicand input.
If the target uses explicit width parameters rather than types, inject the same fault by narrowing the addend parameter or truncating the feedback operand before the MAC.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the MAC helper or DSP block instantiation inside the processing element.
In WS-only mode, change the addend or feedback input width from the output or partial-sum width to the narrower input width.
Leave the rest of the WS datapath unchanged so the error is isolated to the width mismatch.
Do not change OS-mode wiring unless shared logic forces a WS-mode conditional injection.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: PE mac_unit instantiation for WS-only dataflow
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the MAC helper addend type from cType to a WS-specific outputType selection.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the mac_unit instantiation in PE.scala, replace the WS-specific outputType addend selection with the older cType or inputType-based argument.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: WS-mode multiply-accumulate results can be truncated, overflow incorrectly, or otherwise use a malformed feedback width.
evidence_for_injection: The patch is a one-line hardware-type fix in the PE MAC instantiation, not a software or tooling change.
The changed type argument matches the actual WS operand that feeds mac_unit.io.in_c in the surrounding code.
The bug is explicitly gated by WS-only dataflow in the commit subject.
notes: Depending on the target language and type system, the injected bug may manifest as silent truncation or as malformed generated hardware.
For runtime fault injection, prefer targets where the wrong-width change still produces a buildable DUT.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 WS-only PE 中 MAC 操作数的类型选择，使 MAC 的加数输入使用 WS 输出路径位宽，而不是更窄的输入路径类型。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确指出，当使用 WS-only dataflow 时，PE 中存在 bit-width 问题。
补丁修改的是 src/main/scala/gemmini/PE.scala 中 PE 的 MAC 单元实例化，这属于核心 DUT 硬件逻辑。
新的实例化在 WS-only 场景下为加数路径使用 outputType，而不是旧的会在 WS 模式下落到 inputType 的 cType。
evidence: 修复前，WS 模式下的 cType 会落到 inputType，因此 MAC 的加数类型比真实 WS 路径更窄。
修复后，MAC 实例化在 WS 模式下改为使用 outputType 作为加数输入类型。
在 WS 分支里，mac_unit.io.in_c 实际由 b 驱动，而 b 本身就是 outputType，所以修复后的类型与真实数据路径一致。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 weight-stationary 的处理单元中，进入 MAC 的反馈或加数操作数往往比原始乘法输入更宽。旧的 WS-only 类型选择把这个加数端口错误地实例化成更窄的输入路径类型，而不是 WS 输出路径类型。重新注入这种不匹配后，会在 WS 累加路径上重新出现位宽或截断错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: weight-stationary 模式下 PE 的 MAC 加数位宽选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: PE 以 WS-only 配置构建或运行，且输出或部分和路径位宽大于输入操作数位宽。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 实例化 MAC 辅助单元或 DSP 封装时，让加数或反馈操作数使用更窄的输入类型，而不是 WS 输出类型。
portability_notes: 只在 WS 数据路径反馈值比原始乘法输入更宽的设计中注入该故障。
如果目标设计使用显式宽度参数而不是类型，就通过缩窄加数参数或在进入 MAC 前截断反馈操作数来注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位处理单元内部的 MAC 辅助单元或 DSP 模块实例化。
在 WS-only 模式下，把加数或反馈输入位宽从输出或部分和位宽改成更窄的输入位宽。
保持 WS 数据路径其余部分不变，使错误只集中在位宽不匹配上。
除非共享逻辑无法避免，否则不要改动 OS 模式路径。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: PE.scala 中 WS-only dataflow 下的 mac_unit 实例化
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 MAC 辅助单元的加数类型从 cType 改成了 WS 专用的 outputType 选择。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 PE.scala 的 mac_unit 实例化处，把 WS 专用的 outputType 加数选择改回旧的 cType 或 inputType 方案。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: WS 模式下的乘加结果可能被截断、错误溢出，或者因为反馈位宽错误而产生异常输出。
evidence_for_injection: 该补丁是一条发生在 PE MAC 实例化处的硬件类型修复，而不是软件或工具链修改。
变更后的类型参数与周围代码中实际送入 mac_unit.io.in_c 的 WS 操作数相匹配。
提交主题明确指出该 bug 受 WS-only dataflow 条件控制。
notes: 在不同语言和类型系统下，这个错误可能表现为静默截断，也可能表现为畸形生成硬件。
做运行期故障注入时，优先选择那种“错误位宽仍能生成可运行 DUT”的目标。
